title: Yeasty Fluffy Saudi-Arabian Nuts Tagine
description: Energizing breakfast dish featuring nuts and a yeasty, fluffy texture. Ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine almond milk, honey, dates, pistachios, cinnamon powder, cardamom powder, and salt. Mix well until combined.
Add flour to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Add yeast mixture to the dough and mix until a smooth, fluffy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong shape.
Place the dough in a greased tagine or oven-safe pot with a lid.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and cooked through.
Let the bread cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve warm.
Serve with a dollop of honey or a sprinkle of cinnamon powder, if desired.
Store leftover bread at room temperature for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
Reheat frozen bread by wrapping it in a damp cloth and microwaving for 20-30 seconds, or until warmed through.
You can also reheat leftover bread by wrapping it in foil and baking in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 5-10 minutes, or until warmed through.
